chunks: Ishaq ibn 'Ammar asked him, saying to him:
I enter the mosque while the Imam has already gone into ruku', so I bow with his bowing while I am alone, and I prostrate. Then when I raise my head, what should I do?
He said: "Stand and go to them. If they are standing, then stand with them; and if they are sitting, then sit with them."

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, the place where the congregational salat is being performed
key_terms.رَكَعَ: entered into ruku', the bowing posture of salat
key_terms.قِيَامًا: standing upright in the prayer posture
key_terms.وَحْدِي: alone, meaning not yet fully joined into the row

ai.seo_question: What should a latecomer do after catching the Imam in ruku' during congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling about joining congregational salat when one enters late and catches the Imam in ruku'. After completing that movement and rising, the person should rejoin the congregation in whatever posture they are in, whether standing or sitting.
